chosen-mark.$description: The star: After Graduation's mark for a chosen tile. With the fill, it means color is never the only sign a tile is chosen.

chosen-frost.$description: A chosen Glass tile turns milky: this frost over a blur of what's behind it. White frost over the header red: strong enough to read as chosen, while the white text keeps 4.5:1. The text sits on top, untouched.
